details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put a Marine card from among them into your EX area. If Overflow is active for you, it costs 1 less to play this turn. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

issues: The Overflow clause is encoded incorrectly: after putting a Marine card into your EX area, the selected card should get a temporary cost reduction this turn, not this spell itself. Replace the standalone if->playCostReduction with a single searchDeckChoose that includes "playCostReduction": 1 and is gated by Overflow for the selected card.

details.effect: [fanfare] [cost05]: Deal 5 damage to each other follower on the field. Give this follower [attack]+2/[defense]+2 and Storm. At the start of your end phase, if Sanguine is active for you, select an enemy leader or enemy follower on the field and deal it 3 damage.

issues: The fanfare damage effect is wrong: "each other follower on the field" should be encoded with dealDamageOtherFollowers amount 5, not dealDamageAllEnemies followersOnly true.
The fanfare is missing "Give this follower Storm" after the optional [cost05] payment; add a grantKeyword effect for storm targeting self within the paid sequence.

The end phase ability target is wrong: it should target an enemy leader or enemy follower, but enemyFieldCard cannot hit the leader. Encode this as a choice or equivalent targeting that includes enemyLeader as well as enemyFollower.
